name: format_csv
title: Format a data frame as CSV

origin.description: Doubles use the short grisu3 form. A comma inside a field is quoted.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: Doubles use the short grisu3 form. A comma inside a field is quoted.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example: format_csv(data.frame(a = c(1, 1/3, NA), b = c(TRUE, FALSE, NA), c = c("x", "a,b", NA)))
